title: •3,720 To 1
caption: •3,720 To 1 (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Droids are destiny +1. Once per turn, may place the bottom two cards in Lost Pile out of play to deploy from Lost Pile: Forced Servitude, a character weapon, a location, or an Effect that deploys on a location (without “lose” in game text). {alter}
lore: What are the odds of having a Corellian, a Wookiee and a protocol droid together with an Alderaanian princess who happens to be the daughter of the Dark Lord of the Sith?
